mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ji.params_snapshot #>> '{effectiveParams,scheduledAt}' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' THEN (ji.params_snapshot #>> '{effectiveParams,scheduledAt}')::timestamptz ELSE NULL END

CASE WHEN ji.params_snapshot #>> '{effectiveParams,dependencyReadyAt}' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$' THEN (ji.params_snapshot #>> '{effectiveParams,dependencyReadyAt}')::timestamptz ELSE NULL END

mapper.select: SELECT , ji.started_at + (mp.soft_runtime_seconds * interval '1 second') AS monitoring_deadline_at, mp.soft_runtime_seconds AS threshold_seconds, mp.soft_runtime_severity AS severity FROM batch.job_instance ji JOIN batch.job_monitoring_policy mp ON mp.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND mp.job_definition_id = ji.job_definition_id WHERE ji.instance_status = 'RUNNING' AND ji.started_at IS NOT NULL AND ji.dry_run = false AND mp.soft_runtime_seconds > 0 AND ji.started_at + (mp.soft_runtime_seconds * interval '1 second') < current_timestamp AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_monitoring_alert_claim c WHERE c.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND c.job_instance_id = ji.id AND c.violation_type = 'RUNNING_TOO_LONG' ) ORDER BY ji.tenant_id, ji.started_at, ji.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , eligibility.eligible_at + (mp.start_grace_seconds * interval '1 second') AS monitoring_deadline_at, mp.start_grace_seconds AS threshold_seconds, mp.start_grace_severity AS severity FROM batch.job_instance ji JOIN batch.job_monitoring_policy mp ON mp.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND mp.job_definition_id = ji.job_definition_id JOIN batch.job_definition jd ON jd.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND jd.id = ji.job_definition_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS planned_at) scheduled_at CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS ready_at) dependency_ready CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL AND dependency_ready.ready_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(scheduled_at.planned_at, dependency_ready.ready_at), dependency_ready.ready_at) WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NULL AND jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' THEN scheduled_at.planned_at ELSE NULL END AS eligible_at ) eligibility WHERE ji.instance_status IN ('CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING') AND ji.started_at IS NULL AND ji.dry_run = false AND mp.start_grace_seconds > 0 AND eligibility.eligible_at IS NOT NULL AND eligibility.eligible_at + (mp.start_grace_seconds * interval '1 second') < current_timestamp AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_monitoring_alert_claim c WHERE c.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND c.job_instance_id = ji.id AND c.violation_type = 'NOT_STARTED' ) ORDER BY ji.tenant_id, eligibility.eligible_at, ji.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , due.deadline_at AS monitoring_deadline_at, CASE WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL THEN mp.dependency_completion_window_seconds ELSE NULL::integer END AS threshold_seconds, mp.completion_deadline_severity AS severity FROM batch.job_instance ji JOIN batch.job_monitoring_policy mp ON mp.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND mp.job_definition_id = ji.job_definition_id JOIN batch.job_definition jd ON jd.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND jd.id = ji.job_definition_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS planned_at) scheduled_at CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AS ready_at) dependency_ready CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL AND dependency_ready.ready_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(scheduled_at.planned_at, dependency_ready.ready_at), dependency_ready.ready_at) WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NULL AND jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' THEN scheduled_at.planned_at ELSE NULL END AS eligible_at ) eligibility CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL AND mp.dependency_completion_window_seconds > 0 THEN eligibility.eligible_at + (mp.dependency_completion_window_seconds * interval '1 second') WHEN jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' THEN ((scheduled_at.planned_at AT TIME ZONE jd.timezone)::date + mp.completion_deadline_day_offset + mp.completion_deadline_local_time) AT TIME ZONE jd.timezone ELSE NULL END AS deadline_at ) due WHERE (ji.finished_at IS NULL OR ji.finished_at > due.deadline_at) AND COALESCE(ji.finished_at, current_timestamp) >= mp.completion_deadline_updated_at AND ji.dry_run = false AND eligibility.eligible_at IS NOT NULL AND ((jd.depends_on_job_code IS NOT NULL AND (mp.dependency_completion_window_seconds > 0 OR (jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' AND mp.completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL))) OR (jd.depends_on_job_code IS NULL AND jd.schedule_type = 'CRON' AND mp.completion_deadline_local_time IS NOT NULL)) AND due.deadline_at < current_timestamp AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_monitoring_alert_claim c WHERE c.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND c.job_instance_id = ji.id AND c.violation_type = 'NOT_COMPLETED_BY_DEADLINE' ) ORDER BY ji.tenant_id, due.deadline_at, ji.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , ji.finished_at AS monitoring_deadline_at, 0::integer AS threshold_seconds, 'WARN'::varchar AS severity FROM batch.job_instance ji WHERE ji.instance_status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED') AND ji.failed_partition_count > 0 AND ji.finished_at >= current_timestamp - (#{lookbackSeconds} * interval '1 second') AND ji.dry_run = false AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM batch.job_monitoring_alert_claim c WHERE c.tenant_id = ji.tenant_id AND c.job_instance_id = ji.id AND c.violation_type = 'FAILED_PARTITION' ) ORDER BY ji.finished_at, ji.tenant_id, ji.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.job_monitoring_alert_claim (tenant_id, job_instance_id, violation_type) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{jobInstanceId}, #{violationType}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, job_instance_id, violation_type) DO NOTHING
